subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive / pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Oliver Stone <oliver.stone@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Unit economics follow-up from today's call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the usage assumptions and ask for a short note on unit economics so my finance team can evaluate. High level:

- Product: contextual recommendations inside our mobile app (server-side inference)
- Active users: target 350k MAU in year 1, ramping from 50k in month 1 to 350k by month 12
- Average prompts per user per month: 40 (mix of short/long)
- Estimated tokens per prompt (avg): 600 tokens
- Desired pricing signal: target cost per feature and target $/1M tokens for budget planning
- Procurement constraints: prefer hosted if cost effective; open to reserved capacity for better unit economics

Can you send a concise breakdown showing: expected $/1M tokens bands (hosted vs reserved), an example $/feature calculation, and a short note on CAC payback assumptions we should use? Also attaching our internal volume sheet (will send separately) — happy to jump on another call if needed.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Product, FintechX


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Stone <oliver.stone@fintechx.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unit economics follow-up from today's call

Thanks Oliver — great to meet you and appreciate the clear numbers. I'm attaching a quick worksheet (FTX_estimated_volumes.xlsx) with the assumptions you listed and a first-pass cost model. High-level answers below; I'll follow up with Aditya (SE) for model/quantization recommendations.

Quick summary (first pass):
- Volumes: 350k MAU * 40 prompts/mo * 600 tokens/prompt = ~8.4B tokens/mo at steady state
- Short-term ramp: month 1 ~50k MAU -> ~1.2B tokens, month 12 ~8.4B tokens

Pricing bands (illustrative):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): $18 - $28 per 1M generation tokens depending on model & length profile
- Dedicated / Reserved: $7 - $12 per 1M generation tokens (committed volume, multi-month contract)
- Embeddings and retrieval costs are separate; can be blended depending on architecture

Example $/feature calc (steady-state):
- Steady-state tokens/mo: ~8.4B = 8400 blocks of 1M tokens
- At $18/1M (hosted): cost = 8400 * $18 = $151,200 / mo
- At $10/1M (reserved): cost = 8400 * $10 = $84,000 / mo
- Per-MAU monthly inference cost (reserved $10 band): $84,000 / 350,000 = ~$0.24 per MAU / mo
- Per-active-user-per-feature call: if 40 prompts/mo, cost per prompt = (84000 / (350k*40)) = ~$0.006 per prompt

CAC payback & margin context (short):
- CAC payback depends on ARPU and gross margin targets. If target gross margin is 70% and ARPU is $3/mo, you need inference cost + other COGS to be <= $0.9/mo per MAU. In the $10/1M reserved example inference is ~$0.24/mo per MAU, leaving room for model ops + infra.
- Using these numbers, a $50 CAC would pay back in ~17 months at $3/mo ARPU (naive), or faster if upsell/monetization increases LTV. We can run a more detailed cohort model with your finance inputs.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Aditya to confirm model choice and quantization that supports the $7-12/1M reserved band (cc'd).
2) We share a 12-month ramp P&L (I can produce with your sheet).
3) Quick 30-min follow-up with your finance and engineering to validate assumptions and finalize a recommended band.

I'll attach the quick worksheet now. Let me know availability for a 30-min tomorrow or Wed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Stone <oliver.stone@fintechx.com>

Thanks Marissa — that is super helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 600 token average is weighted: 70% of prompts are short (200 tokens), 30% are long (1500 tokens). If caching reduces token needs for short prompts we could see effective tokens drop ~15%.
- Our budget range from procurement is $60k - $120k / mo for inference in year 1; prefer to target <$100k/mo if possible.
- On CAC payback: we currently model ARPU at $2.50/mo and a blended gross margin (non-inference COGS) target of 65%. We need to make sure inference cost doesn't push gross margin below 50% at steady-state.

Could you run the example again with effective token reduction of 15% and show whether the reserved $10/1M band fits the <$100k/mo target? Also happy to set up a 30-min with engineering this week (Thu/Fri preferable).

Oliver

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Oliver — thanks, good data. Quick follow-up and a short unit-econ worked example with the 15% effective token reduction baked in. Attaching an updated worksheet and I can present the numbers on a 30-min call Thursday.

Worked example (steady-state, after 15% token reduction):
- Nominal steady tokens: 8.4B/mo -> effective tokens after caching: 8.4B * 0.85 = 7.14B tokens/mo
- 1M token blocks = 7140

Reserved band @ $10 / 1M:
- Monthly inference cost = 7140 * $10 = $71,400 / mo
- This fits within your target range (< $100k/mo and above your lower bound of $60k).
- Per-MAU monthly inference cost = $71,400 / 350,000 = ~$0.204 / MAU / mo
- Per-prompt cost (40 prompts/mo): $0.204 / 40 = ~$0.0051 / prompt

Margin & CAC impact (with your inputs):
- ARPU = $2.50 / mo. Target non-inference gross margin floor = 65% -> non-inference COGS = $0.875 / MAU / mo (2.5 * (1 - 0.65))
- Allowed inference cost to maintain >=50% gross margin: target gross margin 50% => total COGS must be <= $1.25 / MAU / mo. Given non-inference COGS $0.875, inference budget per MAU <= $0.375. Our $0.204 / MAU inference cost leaves a ~ $0.171 per MAU buffer for other ops.
- CAC payback (naive): with $50 CAC and net contribution margin = ARPU * gross_margin = $2.50 * 0.50 = $1.25/mo => payback ~40 months. If we assume upsell or higher LTV this improves; if they target 70% gross margin, payback reduces to ~23 months. We can model cohort-level payback more accurately if you share CAC and churn.

Recommendations & next steps:
1) Confirm whether you can commit to an initial 6-12 month reserved cadence to hit the ~$10/1M band. We can structure stepped discounts tied to volume thresholds.
2) Aditya to run quick perf/quant eval and confirm expected token reduction with prefix caching (we expect 10-20% as mentioned).
3) Schedule 30-min on Thu/Fri with engineering + procurement to finalize pricing and draft SOW.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 10:00 AM PT if that works — otherwise propose times.

Best,
Marissa Cole
